title: Trichotomy dynamics of a free boundary model for biological invasion
summary: It is well known that the reaction-diffusion equation $u_t=du_{xx}+f(u)$ with compactly supported nonnegative initial functions exhibits trichotomy dynamics for bistable and combustion type $f(u)$ \cite{DM, zlatos}. The same is true for the corresponding Stefan type free boundary problem \cite{DL}.
